items.title: 61428_Red Callender oral history interview
items.q: So I go to the door with my little bass, and Al Morgan is on the stand, and they say to me, "Sorry, kid, we got Al Morgan."

ctx.x: Oh, that was great. Well, I think I stayed there a month or six weeks, then Pops Foster came back, and I resumed my... I can call it a "career" now, although at the time I was just having fun. I was determined to be a good musician.

Around that same time, Cab Calloway's band was out here, and Al Morgan went with the... Al Morgan had quit Cab's band. And I remember being hired for a gig out in Gardenia, at a place called Gloria Nightclub. C.C. Caldwell had the band. And I was hired for this gig, so I go out to the gig, and I get to the door, and I hear a bass in there tuning up. I wonder what's happening. So I go to the door with my little bass, and Al Morgan is on the stand, and they say to me, "Sorry, kid, we got Al Morgan."
